pool.text: The Binat Bibi Mosque was built in the Narinda area of Dhaka.
Dhaka became the capital of the Mughal province of Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa.
Dhaka College, the oldest institution for higher education, was founded in British India.
The Katra Press became the first printing press in the city.
Dacca News became the first English-language newspaper in the city of Dhaka.
The municipality of Dhaka was founded on the first of August.
Haji biryani has been a leading biryani restaurant in the city.
The Dhaka Medical College was established in the city.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange was opened on the twenty-eighth of April.
The Dhaka Improvement Trust was established to coordinate the city development.
The Southeast Asia Treaty Organization established a medical research centre in the city.
The Dhaka Medical School officially became known as Sir Salimullah Medical College.
The Pakistan Army launched military operations under Operation Searchlight against the population.
Bangladesh hosted its first South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation summit in Dhaka.
A mass uprising led to the return of parliamentary democracy in the country.
An election was held for the first elected Mayor of Dhaka.
Four surrounding rivers were declared as ecologically critical areas by the Department of Environment.
The erstwhile Dhaka City Corporation was split into two separate corporations.
The first phase of Dhaka Metro Rail from Uttara to Agargaon was inaugurated.
Bookworm was ordered to relocate from its location near the Prime Minister's Office.
